name: smwgraphics-kirby-s-adventure-ice
title: Kirby's Adventure - Ice
description:
This is the complete ice tileset seen in the later stages of Orange Ocean, most of Rainbow Resort, and in many sub-rooms throughout Kirby's Adventure. I threw in a few extra tiles as well. Best of all, it doesn't use any of SMW's default palette areas, so it won't mess up any of your existing pipe/block colors, etc.

Also comes with ExAnimated water for the foreground and background.
